component.name: BigText
component.summary: Text editor for huge files that never freezes

description.p: BigText opens text files of any size at once, from 1 to 50 GB and more, because it never loads a whole file into memory: a 50 GB log takes about 100 MB of RAM. Scrolling, jumping to a line, searching and saving work in the background, so the window never freezes.

ul.li: Search with regular expressions at a few GB/s, Find All with a list of matches, and Replace All through the whole file
Logs: follow mode like tail -F, jump to a time, filters by level, logs merged by time, and logs on servers over SSH
CSV, TSV and JSON Lines as tables, far past the row limit of spreadsheets
Compare two huge files, a hex view, and .gz, .zst and .xz files opened directly
Editing with undo, and saves that replace the file only when it is completely written
